rows.description: The effective area of a flux loop is the non-negative field-to-flux sensitivity area of the sensor, including the aperture enclosed by each turn, the number of turns, and calibration factors. rows.documentation: The effective area of a flux loop is the non-negative field-to-flux sensitivity factor of the sensor. rows.description: Net parallel plasma current generated by fusion reactions, associated with fast alpha particles produced by deuterium–tritium reactions and distinct from other non-inductive current-drive mechanisms.
rows.documentation: This quantity is the net plasma current attributable to fusion reactions within the plasma, associated with fast alpha particles produced by deuterium–tritium reactions. It represents the parallel current contribution rather than the total plasma current. rows.name: current_due_to_fusion_reactions

rows.description: Alfvén frequency at a given radial position for a single toroidal mode number is the complex local shear-Alfvén continuum angular frequency; its real part gives oscillation and its imaginary part gives growth or damping for the stated time dependence.
rows.documentation: Alfvén frequency at a given radial position for a single toroidal mode number is the complex local shear-Alfvén continuum angular frequency for perturbations propagating along the magnetic field on the flux surface at that radial position. rows.name: alfven_frequency

rows.description: Torque density due to collisional processes is the angular-momentum transfer rate per unit volume imparted to the electron population, encompassing fast and thermal electrons.
rows.documentation: Torque density due to collisional processes is the local rate of angular-momentum transfer to the electron population per unit volume. It is the common parent of the fast- and thermal-electron specializations, which distinguish the electron populations receiving the collisional transfer. changed_between.change: first reading: no closure, no confirming question, no pair table
added a name-implication closure covering species, object, locus, extensive base and unit; one hard-class Jev confirming question; (slot, option) pairs dropped below chance

change: closure narrowed to exact implications only (per-unit-volume, the species' own ions, the named locus, the named transformation, the natural integral); an object token no longer suppresses a restriction; the confirming judgment is graded and each slot's threshold is tuned on development; a Jev extraction arm added

scorings.note: the held-out names have been scored three times: no closure, then the full closure with a hard relation class and a dropped pair table, and now the narrowed closure with a graded judgment and per-slot thresholds

thresholds.rule: per slot, the lowest threshold on the judge's probability that the phrase is a narrower part or a different form, raised jointly one grid step at a time from the worst-contributing slot until the arm's own development false-flag rate is at or under the ceiling; each slot's own curve is reported beside the joint trace. The union arms are tuned the same way with the chat seat's own development flags counted in the instrument they are scored as
